summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Clara Dashboard soft-delete functionality. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified: Trash page, delete dialog, restore functionality, and permanent delete dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/content/{id} correctly soft-deletes content by setting deleted_at field
GET /api/content/admin/deleted correctly returns only soft-deleted items with deleted_by_name
POST /api/content/{id}/restore correctly restores soft-deleted content (admin only)
DELETE /api/content/{id}/permanent correctly removes content completely (admin only)
GET /api/content correctly excludes soft-deleted items from regular list
TrashPage.js displays deleted content with View, Restore, and Delete Forever buttons
Delete dialog shows informative message about soft-delete and WordPress deletion
Permanent delete dialog shows warning about irreversible action
Trash nav item correctly shows in sidebar for admin users only
seed_data_creation: Test content created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Soft-delete feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: DELETE /api/content/{id} (soft delete), GET /api/content/admin/deleted (admin only), POST /api/content/{id}/restore (admin only), DELETE /api/content/{id}/permanent (admin only). Frontend: TrashPage.js at /trash route (admin only), ContentDetailPage.js has improved delete dialog. All tests pass.
